name: The Alliance Needs Thick Leather!
label: Quest
description: The Alliance Needs Thick Leather!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh boy, this is going to be great! Adventurer, the Ahn'Qiraj war effort is in full swing, and I've been put in charge of keeping track of all of the thick leather that comes in. We'll make tons of things with it, but first we need to get a ton of it. And I mean that literally! That's where you come in.
So, do you think you can go out there and bring me back a nice, fat stack of thick leather? Do yah, do yah?!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Is that the thick leather you have there in your pack, adventurer? Is it? I can't wait for you to hand it over! Everyone is going to be so pleased with us don't you think?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, I knew you could do it, adventurer, I just knew it! I'll get these into the right hands as soon as I can. Now, let's see here. Hmm, looks like our tally is coming along rather nicely. You should check back with me in just a moment once I'm done counting to see if we need more. Cuz if we do, you're the one I want out there gathering it up for me!
